name: mcp-packing-list
description: MCP server for packing slips and packing lists: cartons, contents, weights, chargeable weight and what is still to pack. Packing slips that carry no prices: what is in each carton, what it weighs, and what is still to pack.

settings.name: mcp.zovo.one token
settings.description: A free anonymous token from https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/token, or your Pro key. One token is one data space, and it is refreshed for another 30 days on every write.

packing-list.description: Packing slips that carry no prices: what is in each carton, what it weighs, and what is still to pack.
